crossRefs.note: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he…
The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul!…
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Nazareth
people.line: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee

translations.web: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
translations.bsb: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
translations.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
